# NeNe Corpus

> Self-hosted knowledge chat OSS on NENE2 — ingest PDF & CSV, chat with citations.

## Documentation

- README: https://github.com/hideyukiMORI/nene-corpus
- Product vision: docs/explanation/product-vision.md
- Agent guide: AGENTS.md
- OpenAPI: docs/openapi/openapi.yaml
- MCP tools: docs/mcp/tools.json

## Stack

- PHP 8.4, NENE2 framework
- OpenAPI 3.1, RFC 9457 Problem Details
- Planned: SSE chat, Claude tool_use, React admin
